snippet.title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition | Launch trailer
snippet.description:
Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213300/Might__Magic_Clash_of_Heroes__Definitive_Edition/
Buy on Nintendo Swtich (US): https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/might-and-magic-clash-of-heroes-definitive-edition-switch/
Buy on Nintendo Switch (Europe): https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Might-Magic-Clash-of-Heroes-Definitive-Edition-2404644.html
Buy on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10004571

The acclaimed puzzle-RPG Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes returns in a Definitive Edition now available on PC, Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4  (as well as PlayStation 5 via backward compatibility).

Taking place 40 years before the Heroes of Might & Magic V saga, the full Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition experience tells the tale of five heroes scattered across five different regions of Ashan. Plan your next move wisely, every additional combo can make the difference! Whether in solo or duo, online or offline, mix and match your units to defeat your enemies!

#mightandmagic  #tacticalrpg  #rpg
